legal_units.title: Computation of tonnage income.
legal_units.text: The tonnage income of a tonnage tax company for a tax year shall be the aggregate of the tonnage income of each qualifying ship computed as per sub-sections (2) and (3).
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 227 Computation of tonnage income. Section 227(1): The tonnage income of a tonnage tax company for a tax year shall be the aggregate of the tonnage income of each qualifying ship computed as per sub-sections (2) and (3).

legal_units.title: Computation of tonnage income.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of sub-section (1), the tonnage income of each qualifying ship shall be computed as per the following formula:— TI = DTI × N where,— TI = the tonnage income of each qualifying ship; DTI = the daily tonnage income of each qualifying ship; N = the number of days in the tax year or in part of the tax year in case the ship is operated by the company as a qualifying ship for only part of the tax year.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 227 Computation of tonnage income. Section 227(2): For the purposes of sub-section (1), the tonnage income of each qualifying ship shall be computed as per the following formula:— TI = DTI × N where,— TI = the tonnage income of each qualifying ship; DTI = the daily tonnage income of each qualifying ship; N = the number of days in the tax year or in part of the tax year in case the ship is operated by the company as a qualifying ship for only part of the tax year.
